title: himmel harness descriptor
description: One descriptor per coding harness, scripts/harnesses/<id>.json. registry.jq enforces this shape. A descriptor named in x-listed-harnesses that is missing, or any descriptor that is malformed, makes guard-t3-thread-tools.sh and block-read-secrets.sh refuse. An agent may launch a T3 driver only when its descriptor is complete: complete is true and hook_config, event_map, deny_dialect, adapter, egress_provider, lane and quota_source are all set. quota_source may be "pending".

driver.description: The driver value of a providerInstances entry in T3's settings.

instance_ids.description: Built-in instance ids T3 offers with no providerInstances entry.

mcp_prefix.description: How the harness names an MCP tool; null when not captured.

tools.description: Native tool name to the Claude name, with native input keys renamed under keys.

event_map.description: Claude hook event to the harness's event name.

token_paths.description: Login-token files as globs: ~/ for a home path, */ for any root. From vendor documentation only, never from a real file.

egress_provider.description: A key of providers in scripts/guardrails/egress-matrix.json.
